title: processkit MCP tool result
description: structuredContent of every processkit MCP tool result (mcp-context-serving@v1 PK-MCP-058). The text content item of the result holds the same document, serialized with RFC 8785. The processkit CLI puts `data` in its envelope's data and `diagnostics` in its envelope's diagnostics (cli@v1 PK-CLI-040).

apiVersion.description: MCP tool contract version; equals mcpToolContractVersion of processkit version --json.

revision.description: Working-copy revision (repository-storage@v1); null only when the working copy cannot be read.

generation.description: Identifier of the generation the result belongs to (PK-MCP-092); null only when the working copy cannot be read.

data.description: Tool-specific data; schema per tool in interfaces.yaml `tools`. Null when the call failed.
